explanation: The intersections satisfy |x|=(1+√5)/2<2, and D lies between y=x²−1 and y=|x|, entirely inside R. Definitions I and II both equal y/(x²+1) on D and zero on R\D, so both give the required integral. Definition III integrates y/(x²+1) over the whole rectangle. This integral is strictly larger: for each x crossing D, the extra vertical integral is (x⁴−3x²+4)/(2(x²+1))>0; the remaining rectangle slices also have positive integrals. Thus I and II only are valid.
